events.title: Events
events.description: Every event of the division, drafts and past ones included: its settings, its description, its airports with their capacity, and publishing, cancelling, duplicating or deleting it.
events.empty: The events of the division will show up here, from the drafts to the ended ones.
events.readOnly: You can read this event: changing it is for whoever writes the events.

publish.problems: Before it can be published, it still needs:
publish.saveFirst: Save the settings first: «Publish» publishes the event as it is saved.
publish.confirmDescription: It will be on the site, in the calendar and in the search, and it will not go back to a draft: from then on it can only be cancelled.

delete.title: Delete this event?
delete.description: The event, its airports, its routes and its slots are deleted for good. An event somebody took part in cannot be deleted: cancel it instead.

body.unsaved: The description has changes that are not saved.

fields.title: Title
fields.shiftMinutes: Length of a shift, in minutes
fields.restrictedWindowHours: Hours of a band, for whoever books and does not fly
fields.restrictedMaxPerWindow: Slots in each band, at most
fields.restrictedMaxPerEvent: Slots in the event, at most

hints.kind: A kind of the events, as their settings list them: every kind of the calendar while they list none. Choosing it sets the switches below to what the settings say of that kind; change them as this event needs.
hints.publicSlots: Slots the staff prepares, each with its flight, which a pilot books.
hints.privateSlots: Slots generated from the capacity of each airport, for the flight a pilot chooses.
hints.wholeDivision: The event is about every airport and position of the division, as an online day is: it has no airports of its own.
hints.externalUrl: For an event of the network or of another division: their page about it.
hints.visibleFromUtc: Leave it empty to show the event as soon as it is published.
hints.bookingOpensAtUtc: From when pilots book; each slot closes at its own off block time. Leave it empty for an event without slots.
hints.inPerson: People come to the event in person: the members register by answering its questions.
hints.venue: Where the event takes place: its page and the members' emails say it. Needed to publish an event in person, in every language of the division.
hints.hasRoster: The event has an ATC roster: its positions are opened in the tab «ATC», and the controllers give their availability from its page.
hints.shiftMinutes: Each position is cut into shifts this long. Leave it empty for the settings' length.
hints.restrictedWindowHours: A pilot with the limits of whoever books and does not fly books in bands this many hours long, from the start of the event. Leave it empty for the settings' hours.
hints.restrictedMaxPerWindow: How many slots such a pilot books in each band. Leave it empty for the settings' number.
hints.restrictedMaxPerEvent: How many slots such a pilot books in this event. Leave it empty for the settings' number.

cancel.title: Cancel the event
cancel.description: The event stays on its page until its end, marked as cancelled, with the note below.

hints.note: Shown on the page of the event, in every language of the division.

duplicate.title: Duplicate the event
duplicate.description: A new draft with every time moved by the difference between the two starts: the settings, the description, the banner while the library still has it, the airports with their capacity and the routes, and the public slots if you choose. Nothing of the members comes with it: no booking.
duplicate.privateSlots: The private slots are never copied: they are generated again from the capacity of the airports — with the new event when its public slots come with it, or it takes none; otherwise with «Generate the private slots», once its new table is loaded.
duplicate.privateSlotsNotGenerated: The copy is made, as a draft, without its private slots.

hints.startsAtUtc: The start of the new event, in UTC: its end, the opening of its bookings and the times of its slots move by as much.
hints.slug: The address of the new event's page, /events/…: another one than this event's.
hints.publicSlots: With their rotations, at the new times.

airports.empty: The airports of the event will show up here, each with its capacity.

hints.maxMovementsPerHour: The capacity of the airport, as arrivals and departures together. Leave it empty to give arrivals and departures apart.
hints.maxArrivalsPerHour: With the departures, instead of the movements.

hints.arrivalIcao: The ICAO code of an airport the hub knows.
hints.route: The route to file, as a pilot writes it in the flight plan.
hints.remarks: What a pilot should know about it. The page of the event shows it to everybody: written in one language, it is written in every language of the division. Leave it empty for none.

delete.title: Delete this route?
delete.description: The route is taken out of the event and off its page.

slots.title: Slots
slots.empty: The slots of the event will show up here: they are pasted from a table or created one by one.
slots.emptyPrivate: The private slots of the event will show up here, generated from the capacity of its airports.
slots.emptyBoth: The slots of the event will show up here: the public ones are pasted from a table or created one by one, the private ones generated from the capacity of its airports.

hints.callsign: Letters and digits: the callsign the pilot connects with.
hints.mainAircraftType: The aircraft type the slot is for, one the hub knows, by its ICAO code: A320.
hints.otherAircraftTypes: The other aircraft types the slot admits, separated by /: A20N/A321. Leave it empty for the main type alone.
hints.departureIcao: The ICAO code of an airport the hub knows. A slot leaves from an airport of the event, or arrives at one.
hints.arrivalIcao: The ICAO code of an airport the hub knows.

hints.onBlockUtc: The estimated in block time, in UTC.

hints.rotationCode: Any code: the legs of one rotation share it. Leave it empty for a slot alone.

delete.title: Delete this slot?
delete.description: The slot is taken out of the event and off its page. A booked slot is not deleted: take its booking away first.

deleteFree.title: Delete every free slot?
deleteFree.description: Every slot of this event that nobody booked is deleted, public and private. A booked one stays.

generate.title: Generate the private slots?
generate.description: Hour by hour, each airport of the event gets the private slots its capacity leaves room for, at regular intervals, away from the public slots. The free private slots already there are replaced; the ones a pilot booked stay.
generate.done: Private slots generated: {{generated}}. Free ones replaced: {{removed}}; booked ones kept: {{kept}}.

load.title: Paste or load the slots
load.description: The public slots of the event from a table copied from a spreadsheet, or from a CSV file: all of it, or nothing.
load.help: The first row is the header, with these names, in any order; rotation and leg can be left out, and a column the hub does not know is left alone:
load.formats: Times are in UTC, written 2026-10-17 14:30; a slot's time at the airport of the event is within six hours of the event. Aircraft types are separated by /, as A320/A20N: the first is the main one, the others are admitted too. The legs of a rotation share its code; without their places (leg), they take them from their times.
load.refused: Nothing was loaded. Correct these and load the table again:

hints.text: The rows copied from the spreadsheet, the header first, or the text of the CSV file chosen above.
hints.mode: A booked slot is never replaced.

hints.kindPresets: The kinds an event chooses from, each with the switches a new event of that kind starts with; the staff can still change them on the event. The kinds are the words of the calendar. No row at all: an event chooses from every kind of the calendar, with every switch off. A kind with every switch off still needs its row to be chosen.
hints.bookingGapMinutes: Two bookings of one pilot in the same event are at least this far apart, one way or the other, so that one flight can end before the next starts.
hints.pilotRetentionMonths: After this many months from the end of an event, the bookings and the reports of support of its pilots are deleted.
hints.reminderLeadHours: The pilot receives the reminder of a booking this many hours before its off block time.
hints.inPersonRetentionMonths: After this many months from the end of an event in person, its registrations and the seats of its activities are deleted; the sums stay in its statistics.
hints.shiftMinutes: The length of a shift when the event does not say its own.
hints.minimumAtcRating: A member below it does not give their availability. Empty: any member.
hints.maxConsecutiveShifts: The roster proposes nobody for more shifts than this one after the other.
hints.breakShifts: After that many in a row, a controller rests this many shifts before the next one.
hints.applicationsCloseDays: The controllers give and change their availability until this many days before the start; then the roster is proposed.
hints.rosterPublishDays: The roster is published this many days before the start: no more than the days of the close, so the staff have time to correct it.
hints.experienceMonths: How far back the positions a controller opened count when the roster is proposed.
hints.attendanceMinimumMinutes: After the event, a controller who was on their position at least this many minutes within a shift attended it; less, and the shift is proposed as a no-show. A shorter shift asks its whole length.
hints.noShowWeight: The penalty of a controller is this weight times their no-shows, divided by their shifts attended plus their no-shows plus two: the lower, the sooner the roster proposes them.
hints.unflownThreshold: A pilot with this many bookings the check found not flown, in the months the bookings are kept, books with the limits below. The staff take a booking out of a pilot's record by hand.
hints.restrictedWindowHours: The bands start at the start of the event, each this many hours long. An event can say its own.
hints.restrictedMaxPerWindow: How many slots a pilot with the limits books in each band. An event can say its own.
hints.restrictedMaxPerEvent: How many slots a pilot with the limits books in an event. An event can say its own.
hints.reportDays: After an event, its members send their reports of support — the flights they flew, the shifts they controlled — and correct them until they are decided, for this many days from its end.

registrationRemoved.title: Registrations taken away

atcShiftRemoved.title: ATC shifts taken away

errors.slotTwice: The event already has a slot with this callsign at this off block time.
errors.slotNotPublic: A private slot is not corrected as a flight.
errors.exportDraft: This event is a draft: it is exported once it is published.
errors.bookingsContract: Say which version of the contract the program speaks, in the Hub-Bookings-Contract header.
errors.bookingPrivateSlot: A private slot is booked from its own form, with the flight you fly.
errors.slotNotInRotation: This slot is not a leg of a rotation.
errors.bookingCancelledEvent: This event is cancelled: its slots are booked no more.
errors.bookingNotOpen: The bookings of this event are not open yet.
errors.slotClosed: This slot is closed: its off block time has passed.
errors.slotJustTaken: Slot just taken by another pilot.
errors.bookingTryAgain: Too many bookings in the same instant: nothing was booked. Try again.
errors.bookingIncompatible: Too close to another of your bookings in this event: there are fewer minutes than the event asks between the end of one and the start of the other.
errors.aircraftNotAllowed: This slot does not allow this aircraft type.
errors.slotGone: This slot is no longer in the event.
errors.slotBooked: A pilot booked this slot: take the booking away before deleting it.
errors.eventHasBookings: Pilots booked slots of this event: it cannot be deleted. Cancel it instead.
errors.noPrivateSlots: This event has no private slots: switch them on in its settings first.
errors.noCapacity: No airport of this event has a capacity: give one in the tab of the airports, then generate them.
errors.privateSlotsTooMany: That would be more than 5,000 private slots: check the capacity of the airports and the times of the event.
errors.slotNotPrivate: This is a public slot: it is booked as it is, with «Book».
errors.otherIsTheSlots: This is the airport of the slot: write the other airport of your flight.
errors.offBlockPassed: This off block time has passed: a flight is booked before it leaves.
errors.pairedOnlyForArrival: Only an arrival books a departure with it.
errors.pairedNotADeparture: The linked departure is a private departure from the airport the arrival lands at.
errors.pairedTooSoon: The departure leaves too soon: after the arrival lands, it leaves at least the minutes between two bookings of a pilot later.
errors.answerChoice: Choose among the choices of the question.
errors.answerText: Write the answer as a text.
errors.registrationClosed: Registrations to this event are closed: it has started, or it is cancelled.
errors.inPersonHasQuestions: The event still has questions, activities or registrations: take the registrations away and delete the questions and the activities first.
errors.eventHasRegistrations: Somebody registered to this event: cancel it instead.
errors.questionNotInPerson: The event is not in person: switch «In person» on in its settings first.
errors.questionsTooMany: An event asks at most 30 questions.
errors.questionAnsweredType: Somebody already answered this question: its kind of answer stays.
errors.questionAnsweredChoices: Somebody already answered this question: its choices can be rewritten and added to, not taken away.
errors.questionChoicesOnlyForChoice: Only a question with one choice or several choices has choices.
errors.availabilityClosed: This event takes no availability now: it has no position yet, it is cancelled, or availabilities are closed.
errors.ratingTooLow: Your ATC rating is below the one this event asks for.
errors.windowOutsideEvent: The window is outside the hours of the event.
errors.windowsOverlap: This window meets another one: join them.
errors.positionUnknown: Not a position of the division.
errors.eventHasNoRoster: The event has no roster: switch on «ATC roster» in its settings first.
errors.positionOutsideEvent: The position opens or closes outside the hours of the event.
errors.positionTwice: The event opens this position already in hours that meet these.
errors.hasRosterRows: The event still has positions or availabilities: delete its positions first; with availabilities, cancel the event instead.
errors.eventHasAvailabilities: Some controllers gave their availability for this event: cancel it instead.
errors.ratingUnknown: Choose a rating of the list.
errors.rosterBeforeClose: The roster is published after the availabilities close: no more days than those.
errors.positionOnCancelledEvent: The event is cancelled: no position is opened or changed on it.
errors.positionOnEventOver: The event is over: no position is opened or changed on it.
errors.positionUnknownForShift: Choose one of the positions of this event.
errors.positionOfAnotherEvent: A shift moves only among the positions of its own event.
errors.shiftOutsidePosition: The shift is outside the hours of its position.
errors.shiftTaken: Another controller holds this position in these hours.
errors.controllerNeverSignedIn: This member has never signed in to the hub: they cannot be given a shift.
errors.rosterNotProposed: The roster is not proposed yet: it is when the availabilities close.
errors.positionHasShifts: The position has shifts in the roster: its callsign and hours stay around them, and once the event has started it is not deleted.
errors.eventHasShifts: The event has shifts in its roster: cancel it instead.
errors.eventHasReports: This event has reports of support: it is kept.
errors.shiftAfterStart: The event has started: a shift keeps its controller, its position and its hours already past, and is not taken away; only its end can be cut, to now or later.
errors.controllerBusy: This controller already holds another position of the event in these hours.
errors.availabilityChanged: Your availability changed in another window meanwhile: reload the page to see it as it is now, and change it from there.
errors.transferClosed: A shift is handed over until the event starts, once its roster is published.
errors.transferPending: A request to hand this shift over is waiting already.
errors.transferToYourself: The shift is yours already: name somebody else.
errors.transferNotPending: This request was decided already, or taken back.
errors.transferShiftNotTheirs: The shift is no longer theirs: refuse the request.
errors.transferNeedsSubstitute: The request names nobody: choose who takes the shift.
errors.transferChanged: The request changed a moment ago: read the page again.
errors.activityNotInPerson: The event is not in person: switch «In person» on in its settings first.
errors.activitiesTooMany: An event has at most 20 activities.
errors.activityOutsideEvent: The activity has to fit inside the event, from its start to its end.
errors.activityNoTurn: Not even one turn fits between the first turn and the last one.
errors.activityTooManyTurns: An activity has at most 200 turns: make the turns longer or the window shorter.
errors.activitySeatsTaken: Members have taken seats in this activity: every seat has to stay on one of its turns, and no turn can offer fewer seats than are taken.
errors.activityHasSeats: Members have taken seats in this activity: it is not deleted.
errors.seatNoTurn: This is not a turn of the activity.
errors.seatOverlaps: You already have a turn at that time.
errors.seatAlreadyYours: You already have a seat in this turn.
errors.eventActivitiesOutside: An activity of the event would be outside it: move the activity first.
errors.statsBeforeEnd: The statistics of an event are worked out after its end.
errors.statsOfADraft: A draft has no statistics: it never took place.
errors.bookingRestrictedWindow: No more slots in these hours: you have the limits of whoever books and does not fly.
errors.bookingRestrictedEvent: No more slots in this event: you have the limits of whoever books and does not fly.
errors.attendanceNotOver: The event is not over: how its shifts went is not known yet.
errors.attendanceDecided: The shift has that outcome already.
errors.bookingNotUnflown: Only a booking the check after the event found not flown comes out of the record.
errors.bookingAlreadyExcused: This booking is out of the record already.
errors.registerChanged: It changed a moment ago: read the page again.
errors.reportClosed: This event no longer takes reports of support: they are sent in the days after its end.
errors.reportDecided: This report has been decided: it can no longer be corrected.
errors.reportTooManyItems: A report holds at most 20 items.
errors.reportAirportUnknown: The hub does not know this airport.
errors.reportNotAtTheEvent: The flight touches none of the event's airports.
errors.reportOutsideTheEvent: This is outside the hours of the event.
errors.reportShiftTooLong: A shift lasts at most twelve hours.
errors.reportShiftsOverlap: This shift meets another one of the report.
errors.reportStateNotAllowed: A report is accepted or rejected.
errors.reportChanged: The report changed a moment ago: read it again.
errors.awardRuleCriterion: Choose a criterion of the list.
errors.awardRuleAwardUnknown: Choose an active award of the catalogue.
errors.awardRulesTooMany: An event has at most 50 rules of award.
errors.awardRuleInPerson: An event in person takes no report of support, so no rule of award.
errors.awardRulePositionType: The division has no position of this kind.
errors.reportAwardAssigned: An award has been assigned from this report: its decision no longer changes.

questions.title: Questions
questions.empty: The questions a member answers to register for the event will show up here.

hints.ordinal: The questions are asked lowest first.
hints.type: Once somebody has answered the question, its kind of answer stays.
hints.label: The members read it in their language: write it in every language of the division.
hints.choices: Only for one choice or several choices, at least two. Once somebody has answered the question, its choices can be rewritten, reordered and added to, not taken away.
hints.required: Without an answer the registration is not accepted. A yes or no always has one.

delete.title: Delete this question?
delete.description: The question leaves the form. The answers already given to it are no longer shown nor counted.

registrations.empty: The members' registrations for the event will show up here, with their answers.

remove.title: Take away this registration?
remove.description: The member is no longer registered, and receives an email with the reason.

hints.reason: In your own words: the member reads it in the email, and it is kept nowhere else.

atc.title: Events ATC
atc.description: The events with a roster still to end: the positions each one opens, and who is available to control them.
atc.empty: No event with a roster to come.
atc.head: Availabilities close on {{date}}. A shift lasts {{minutes}} minutes.
atc.readOnly: You read the positions of this event: changing them is for the staff of its ATC.

positions.title: Positions
positions.empty: The positions the event opens will show up here; once they are open, the controllers give their availability.

hints.callsign: One of the positions of the division.
hints.fromUtc: In UTC. Leave it empty for the start of the event.
hints.toUtc: In UTC. Leave it empty for the end of the event.
hints.note: For the staff: the members do not read it.

delete.title: Delete this position?
delete.description: The position is no longer opened at this event, and nobody is proposed on it.

candidates.title: Who is available
candidates.empty: Nobody has given their availability in these hours yet.

atc.closedEvent: The event is cancelled or over: its positions are read, not changed.

roster.title: Roster
roster.notYet: The roster is proposed when the availabilities close, on {{date}}.
roster.proposed: Proposed on {{date}}. Correct it until the event ends: a shift outside the rules is a warning, never a refusal.
roster.empty: No shift and nothing uncovered: the event opens no position yet.

remove.title: Take this shift away?
remove.description: The controller no longer has it, and that piece of the position is uncovered again.

decidedBy.Only: The only one who could take it
decidedBy.Preferred: Holds the preferred rating for this kind of position
decidedBy.Experience: Opened this position, or its kind, more often
decidedBy.Vid: Everything else equal: the lower VID

why.connections: Connections: {{callsign}} on this position, {{type}} on its kind
why.noExperience: Experience not counted: no archive of sessions answered
why.uncoveredBusy: Could take it: {{count}}, but they are in other shifts or at their most in a row

warnings.NotAvailable: Not available for the whole shift
warnings.BelowMinimum: Rating below the least of the settings
warnings.BelowPreferred: Rating below the preferred one for this kind of position
warnings.Overlapping: Another shift of theirs in the same hours
warnings.TooManyInARow: More shifts in a row than the settings allow

roster.publishesOn: It is published on {{date}}: the controllers are told then, and of every change after it.
roster.published: Published on {{date}}: every change is told to the controller at once.

hints.positionId: One of the positions of this event.
hints.fromUtc: In UTC, inside the hours of the position.
hints.toUtc: In UTC, inside the hours of the position.
hints.controllerVid: Anybody who signed in to the hub once, whether or not they gave their availability: what leaves the rules is a warning on the roster.

transfers.title: Shifts to hand over
transfers.empty: Nobody asked to hand a shift over.
transfers.stale: The shift is no longer theirs
transfers.approveDescription: The shift passes to the member named, or to another one you choose; both are told.
transfers.approveNobody: Nobody was named: choose who takes the shift. Both are told.
transfers.refuseDescription: The shift stays theirs. Say why: they read it in a mail.

hints.toVid: The member named, or another one who signed in to the hub once.
hints.note: Whoever asked reads it in a mail.

transfers.warningsFor: VID {{vid}} does not keep every rule of the roster for this shift:

roster.title: ATC roster: {{title}}
roster.lead: Every shift of the evening, position by position, and the hours nobody holds yet. The times are in UTC.
roster.signIn: Sign in to see who holds each shift.

activities.title: Activities
activities.empty: The parallel activities of the event will show up here, each with its turns and its seats.

hints.name: The members read it in their language: write it in every language of the division.
hints.place: A room, a hangar: written in every language, or in none for the venue of the event.
hints.toUtc: In UTC, inside the event. The turns that fit whole are offered.
hints.seatsPerSlot: How many members take a turn together: two simulators are two seats. From 1 to 100.

delete.title: Delete this activity?
delete.description: The activity leaves the event's page. An activity somebody took a seat in is not deleted.

seats.empty: The seats the members take in the turns of the activities will show up here.

stats.none: No statistics yet: they are worked out by the checks after the event, a few hours after its end.
stats.checksPending: The checks after the event are not finished: some bookings and shifts may still be to check, and who flew without booking is not counted yet.
stats.checksDone: The checks after the event were done on {{date}}.
stats.wholeDivision: An event of the whole division: who flew without booking is not counted.

bookings.title: Bookings after the event
bookings.empty: The bookings of the event, with what the checks found, will show up here.

shifts.title: Shifts after the event
shifts.empty: The shifts of the roster, with how each went, will show up here.

stats.notCounted: Who flew without booking was not counted: the event has no airports, or the network did not answer for thirty days after it.
stats.countedAt: Who flew without booking was counted at {{counted}} of its {{airports}} airports: the network did not answer for the others.

controllers.title: Controllers' register
controllers.description: Every controller with a shift of an event over: attended, no-shows, excused, still to decide, and the penalty the roster weighs them with. A controller opens on their shifts, where the staff decide them.
controllers.empty: The controllers with a shift of an event over will show up here.
controllers.nothing: No shift of an event over.
controllers.counts: Attended {{attended}} · no-shows {{noShows}} · excused {{excused}} · to decide {{toDecide}} · penalty {{penalty}}

pilots.title: Pilots' register
pilots.description: Every pilot with a booking the check after the event found not flown, in the months the bookings are kept: the ones that count, the ones taken out, and whether they book with the limits. A pilot opens on their bookings, where the staff take one out of the record.
pilots.empty: The pilots with a booking not flown will show up here.
pilots.nothing: No booking not flown in the record.
pilots.counts: Not flown and counting {{counted}} · taken out {{excused}}
pilots.countsLimited: Not flown and counting {{counted}} · taken out {{excused}} · books with the limits until {{date}}

bookings.empty: The pilot's bookings will show up here.
bookings.excuseDescription: The booking stops counting among the ones not flown, for good. Say why: the pilot reads it in their record.

hints.note: A failure of the network, of the hub: what made the flight impossible.

shifts.empty: The shifts of the events over will show up here, with how each went.
shifts.decideDescription: How the shift went: a no-show confirmed weighs on the roster of the next events; attended and excused stay as they are.
shifts.takeAwayDescription: The no-show becomes excused — or attended, if it was a mistake — and stops weighing on the roster. To excuse, say why.

hints.note: Needed to excuse: what happened. The controller reads it in their register.

shifts.changeDescription: How the shift went, changed: no outcome is final, and the audit keeps every step. To excuse, say why; without a note the shift keeps the one it had.

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.description: How each shift went, as the check after the event found it, and as the staff decided. Nobody decides their own shift.

reports.empty: Nobody sent a report of support for this event.

fields.lines: Items and what the check found

check.tooShort: Not enough: {{minutes}} minutes on the position
check.unavailable: Not checked: the network did not answer

reports.decideDescription: Accept or reject it. The member reads your note in a mail; to reject, say why.

hints.note: The member reads it in a mail. Required to reject.

awardRules.title: Rules of award
awardRules.empty: The rules that point out for an award the members whose report of support is accepted will show up here.

hints.criterion: What an accepted report has to show. Only the items the check found count.
hints.awardId: An active award of the catalogue. Whoever assigns the awards finds the member in their queue and decides.
hints.departureIcao: The ICAO code of an airport the hub knows.
hints.arrivalIcao: The ICAO code of an airport the hub knows.
hints.distanceNm: Between the two airports of the flight, from 1 to 10800.
hints.minutes: On the shifts the check found, all together, from 1 to 1440.
hints.positionType: Only the minutes on positions of this kind. Empty: any position.

explain.AnyFlight: A pilot report with at least one flight found.
explain.MinFlights: A pilot report with at least as many flights found as the number below.
explain.Route: A pilot report with a flight found from one airport to the other.
explain.RouteTimes: A pilot report with at least as many flights found from one airport to the other as the number below.
explain.MinLegDistance: A pilot report with a flight found between two airports at least that far apart.
explain.AnyShift: An ATC report with at least one shift found.
explain.MinAtcMinutes: An ATC report with at least that many minutes on the positions, on one kind of position if you choose one.

parameters.distance: a flight of at least {{number}} NM

delete.title: Delete this rule?
delete.description: The rule no longer points anybody out. What it already put in the queue of the awards stays there.
